div.head: Af 23.2
div.ab: Gif se hund ma misdæda gewyrce, ⁊ he hine hæbbe, bete be fullan were swa dolhbote swa he gewyrce.
Gif se hund ma misdæda gewyrce, ⁊ he hine hæbbe, bete be fullan were swa dolgbote swa he wyrce.
Si canis amplius peccet et habeat eum, emendetur plena wera sic malum sicut inflixerit.
Gif se hund ma misdæda gewyrce, ⁊ he hine hæbbe, bete be fullan were swa dolgbote swa he wryce.
If the dog commits more misdeeds, and he keeps it, let [the owner] pay according to the full wer for any wound [the dog] inflicts.
If the dog commits more offences and he [its master] still keeps it, he must pay compensation for whatever wounds that may be inflicted, according to the amount of [the injured man's] full wergeld.
If the dog commits more offences, and the owner retains it, he is to pay compensation for such wounds as the dog inflicts, according to the full wergild.
Wenn der Hund mehr Missethaten verübt, und der [Herr dennoch] ihn behält, büsse dieser [dem Verletzten] nach dessen vollem Wergelde je die Wundenbusse wie der [Hund] verwirkt.
If the dog commits more misdeeds, and [the owner nevertheless] keeps it, let the latter compensate [the injured party] according to his full wergeld, wound-compensation for whatever [the dog] does.
